entries.title: Shopping to bar-hopping: USS Abraham Lincoln sailors unwind in Thailand after 250-day voyage
entries.summary: With military haircuts and moustaches, the US sailors stood out against the flip-flops of the usual Pattaya crowd, writes the BBC's Jonathan Head.
entries.title_zh: 购物到酒吧：亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰水手经过 250 天的航行后在泰国放松身心
entries.summary_zh: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 的乔纳森·海德 (Jonathan Head) 写道，留着军装发型和小胡子的美国水兵在芭堤雅普通人字拖人群中脱颖而出。

entries.title: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
entries.summary: British and French leaders will be at the British Museum to see the exhibition of the historic Bayeux Tapestry.
